workspaceRevision.description: Non-negative revision; Dart and Rust codecs enforce the bound on encode and decode.

deadlineUnixMillis.description: Non-negative Unix-millisecond deadline; Dart and Rust codecs enforce the bound on encode and decode.

capabilities.description: Unique capability names; the Dart codec validates and snapshots the list at construction (post-construction mutation cannot emit duplicates), and both codecs reject duplicates on encode and decode.
